description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Mental Mutation

Your deluded mind believes that you are capable of wielding the Winds of Magic. Choose which specific type of magic you think you’ve mastered. You will adopt the trappings of a sorcerer, like the staff and robes, strike arcane poses and rabble jabberwocky when you think you are casting magic. You may even dabble with special effects like flash powder to add some oomph to your delivery. You’ll go any length to rationalise the lack of effect or claim credit for the results that spring from other sources. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.77p3QRKgFWakkndF]{Blather} Talent. Make an Average (+20) Cool Test when you wake up every morning to see if your powers are working. If you pass you feel that the Winds are weak and not available and you won’t do anything to rely on your powers for the rest o the day. If you fail you feel that the Winds are blowing strong and will try to use your magic when ordinary Talents or Skills would make more sense. If you are an actual wizard, you believe that you are the stuff of legend and that your powers far outreach your actual capacity. The Chosen of Khorne cannot gain this mutation, nor can those with the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.QyjWtSdnVMT04l5Y]{Bless} or @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.voV0C2ar1bKpcpnH]{Invoke} Talents.
